note: Recorded Hindi to English translations of the sample voice brief.

entries.छात्रों के लिए एक मोबाइल एप्लिकेशन भी हो: There should also be a mobile application for students, because most students have only a mobile phone.
entries.ज़िला समाज कल्याण अधिकारी को एक डैशबोर्ड: The District Social Welfare Officer needs a dashboard showing the pending applications of every institution and how long they have been pending.
entries.अगर आवेदन अस्वीकार होता है तो छात्र को S: If an application is rejected, the student should be told the reason for rejection by SMS and be given one chance to correct it and apply again.
